It is a common pairing for weddings over about 150 guests, and standard for trade show stands where footfall is spread across a day rather than concentrated in an evening.

faqs.q: Why choose an enclosed booth over an open-air booth?
faqs.a: Privacy. Guests behave differently behind a curtain — the poses get sillier and more genuine, and the strips show it. The enclosed booth also brings the nostalgia of the classic format, printed strips included, which open-air setups can imitate but never quite match. If you want a booth the whole room watches, choose the mirror; if you want the photos people keep, the curtain earns its space.

faqs.q: How many people fit inside the enclosed booth?
faqs.a: Couples and small groups fit comfortably, and part of the fun is seeing how many friends can squeeze in for one strip. For big group shots alongside the strips, pair it with one of our open-air booths — plenty of events run both.

faqs.q: Is this the same as a vintage photo booth?
faqs.a: It is the vintage format — enclosed cabinet, pull-shut curtain, printed strips — with modern internals: a pro-grade DSLR, studio lighting and instant digital sharing. You get the film-booth feel without the film-booth wait.

faqs.q: How much does a photo booth rental cost in NYC?
faqs.a: Pricing depends on which booth you choose, how many hours you need, and where your venue is. Every quote is built for your specific event rather than pulled off a rate card, so the fastest way to a real number is the quote form — it takes about 30 seconds. Additional hours beyond your booked time are $125 per hour.

faqs.q: Is an attendant included with the photo booth rental?
faqs.a: Yes. A trained attendant runs every booth for the full length of your rental — setting up, keeping the prop table organized, helping guests, and packing down afterward. You never have to assign someone from your own team to look after the booth.

faqs.q: How much space does the booth need?
faqs.a: Optimal setup is 10ft x 10ft, which leaves room for the backdrop, prop table and a red carpet. We can compress into a smaller footprint when a venue is tight — the minimum is 8ft x 8ft with 7.5ft of ceiling clearance. We also need a standard 110V, 5-amp, 3-prong outlet within 15 feet of the booth.

faqs.q: How long does setup take?
faqs.a: About 20 minutes from the moment we walk in until we are taking the first picture. We arrive a full hour before your scheduled start time so everything is tested and ready. If you need us on site earlier than that, idle time is $55 per hour.

faqs.q: Do you carry insurance and can you provide a COI for my venue?
faqs.a: Yes. We carry a $2 million insurance policy. If your venue needs a certificate of insurance naming them as additionally insured, reply to your booking confirmation with their contact email and we will send it over.
